description: LLM serving cost constants bootstrapped from the heterogeneous-inference-runtime project's GPU prefill/decode simulation artifacts. These are NOT measurements on any Apple device. They serve as calibration priors when a device-specific benchmark is unavailable.

source.gpu_batch_scaling_truth_boundary: synthetic transformer workload measured on GTX 1650 Max-Q CUDA 12.4 fp16; hidden_size=4096 n_heads=32; different architecture and model config than Apple A16

cost_constants.prefill_ms_per_token_derivation: 38.316 ms / 1024 tokens from source artifact prefill_latency_ms
cost_constants.decode_ms_per_token_derivation: avg_decode_latency_ms from source artifact; traces to Metal plan_benchmark_results calibrated from GTX 1650 batch scaling

omitted_constants.pd_bandwidth_mb_per_ms_reason: No bandwidth measurement exists in the runtime project artifacts; compiler built-in default will apply

intended_use: Bootstrap prior for first-generation Apple device compiler target profiles pending real on-device benchmark calibration
